connector.name: Frisk
connector.registryDescription: Screen the counterparty of an x402 payment before an agent pays it. Runs offline by default.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package frisk-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.tryfrisk, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FRISK_API_KEY
env.description: Hosted API key. Without it the server screens entirely offline.

env.name: FRISK_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the hosted endpoint. Defaults to https://api.tryfrisk.dev.
